title: A catalog item as the Create form posts it. Written by the AI tester from BUSINESS_RULES.md and corrected after the first run (part 5): the form has no picture field, and the number fields are not required by any rule. The person reviews it before the rows mean anything.

Name.description: RULE-011: required; the 50-character limit exists only in the database, so against UseMockData=true a longer name is saved, and against the database it gives an error page, not a field message (suspected defect). The rows for the limit are in the db-only case file

Description.description: RULE-011: optional. No rule and no attribute limits its length (the 200 guessed in part 4 was answered by the run: none)

Price.description: RULE-013: 0 to 1,000,000 with at most two decimals; 19.999 is rejected, 19.50 and 0 are accepted. Not required: no rule says so, and a post without it binds to 0 (a browser always sends the field). RULE-013 says 1,000,000.01 fails the Range rule; the run showed it is saved (defect D-03)

CatalogBrandId.description: RULE-012: must reference an existing brand; RULE-030: the seed has 5 brands. The database enforces it, UseMockData=true does not: the unknown-brand rows are in the db-only case file

CatalogTypeId.description: RULE-012: must reference an existing type; RULE-030: the seed has 4 types. As for the brand

AvailableStock.description: RULE-014: 0 to 10 million; 'The field Stock must be between 0 and 10 million.' Not required by any rule; absent binds to 0 (question Q-13 for the owner)

RestockThreshold.description: RULE-014; not required by any rule

MaxStockThreshold.description: RULE-014; RULE-022: no rule relates it to RestockThreshold. Not required by any rule

OnReorder.description: RULE-022: never derived; a plain flag
